// purpose: Type-check-only config. Same as tsconfig.json but module=esnext so import.meta (used in webpack's new URL(..., import.meta.url) worker pattern) type-checks. tsc --noEmit uses this; ts-jest and ts-node keep the base commonjs tsconfig.json, so the test/dev toolchains are unaffected.
// paths: yauzl is pinned to the app's own @types/yauzl (3.x): the dev setup links src/node_modules to release/app/node_modules, which can hold an older @types/yauzl (2.x, no openPromise). Only here, never in tsconfig.json: webpack resolves runtime imports through tsconfig paths.
